---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of what the problem is. Ex. "I always have to crop the PDF because […]"

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should happen, from the user's point of view (UI labels, flow, output).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other ways you tried to get the same result.

**Scope check**
- [ ] Concerns the PDF output (layout, TOC, links, diagrams…)
- [ ] Concerns the app UI (workflow, i18n EN/中文, options)
- [ ] Concerns packaging / distribution
- [ ] Other: …

**Additional context**
Mockups, sample wiki snippets, or anything that clarifies the ask. A sample
`.qoder/repowiki` folder that shows the need is the most useful artifact —
send it by email (contact@hellodati.com) if it can't be shared here.
